findings.actualProblem: Eight legs without antennae do not establish a true spider. Ticks, mites and harvestmen also belong to arachnids. The generic key and expected spider classification overstate the visible features, despite correctly declining species identification.
findings.boundedCorrection: Use Spinnentier / arachnid in the generic branch and answer, or supply additional true-spider diagnostic features. No operative goal-text change needed.

findings.actualProblem: The expected answer uses plant components as evidence of the biocenosis, although leaf-litter samples contain dead plant material. It should distinguish actually observed living organisms from dead organic substrate; leaf fragments alone are not a living community member.
findings.boundedCorrection: State living plants or roots where actually observed, and distinguish dead litter as substrate/food from living organisms. Keep actual own investigation and digital protocol requirements intact.
